title: Local video evidence and clear task recovery
summary: Staging candidate: inspect local video contact sheets before optional cloud speech analysis, with clear results and original-task recovery.
highlights: Keep internal identifiers and recovery mechanics in execution records; explain results, limits and known cost in chat.
Reuse existing authorization and preserve user intent when correcting definite pre-submission input errors.
Recover interrupted research by its saved original identity; preserve already submitted batch results.
Start CLI video analysis with local contact sheets, refine visual questions locally, and use cloud analysis only for important speech that subtitles cannot establish.
